statement_en: If the domain is not connected, for example $U=A\cup B$ with $A,B$ disjoint open sets, define $$f(z):=\begin{cases}0&z \in A\\ 1&z \in B\end{cases}.$$ Then $f$ is holomorphic on $U$ and is not identically zero, but its zeros are not isolated.
key_techniques: failure of isolated zeros without connectedness
prerequisites: open sets in the complex plane
callout_body:
假设不是连通的一个开集,比如$U=A\cup B$,其中$A,B$是两个不相交的开集。
$$f(z):=\begin{cases}0&z \in A\\ 1&z \in B\end{cases}$$
此时函数在$U$上全纯，并且不恒等于0，但是零点也非孤立。
